intro: We do not publish a rate card, because two slabs with identical square footage can be an order of magnitude apart in cost. Here is exactly what we look at on the assessment, and what you get back in writing.
notes: Assessments are free and carry no obligation. Repairs are quoted per site after we have identified the failure mode; coatings and resurfacing price by area, joint repair and line marking by linear foot. Ask about a scheduled preventative-maintenance program if you are budgeting a multi-site or multi-year floor plan.
